correctness.rationale: For r>=2 with 0<epsilon<1 and 0<alpha_i<=1, c=(epsilon,(1-epsilon)/r,...), the Volterra quadratic update is exactly the reversible row-stochastic star chain P: x_{i,-}x_{j,+}-x_{i,+}x_{j,-}=c_ic_j(q_j-q_i). Positivity and irreducibility give a simple zero eigenvalue and r positive relaxation eigenvalues. Schur complement of epsilon*z I-L yields epsilon^r*z*[U(z)-(1-epsilon)z U'(z)/r]; the leading factor epsilon and coefficient multipliers 1-(1-epsilon)k/r>=epsilon prove unique recovery of the unordered alpha_i including repetitions. This identity was independently checked in exact SymPy arithmetic for alpha=(1/5,1/2,3/4), epsilon=2/7 and all four polynomial coefficients. For slow time, exact u_{n+1}=u_n+epsilon Q u_n+epsilon alpha e_n and |e_n|<=(1-A/2)^n+2epsilon/A make the forcing summable up to n<=T/epsilon. Markov-semigroup Euler convergence gives the stated uniform O(epsilon) bound and fast hub layer. Q has positive off-diagonals, zero row sums; the secular equation yields strict roots between pairwise distinct alpha_i, while trace gives the fast eigenvalue A+O(epsilon). Repeated couplings have no claimed strict interlacing.
